title: Clinical fidelity tests: omission, fabrication & laterality validation

test_cases.name: Fidelity test suite volume verification
test_cases.expected_result: >= 20 fidelity test cases defined in test suite
test_cases.evidence: Test suite contains 168 automated schema/fidelity test cases (>= 20)

test_cases.name: Schema baseline validation pass
test_cases.input_setup: Instantiate and validate baseline clinical model
test_cases.evidence: Baseline schema validation passes with zero errors

test_cases.name: Omission detection
test_cases.input_setup: Submit clinical dictionary missing mandatory chief_complaint
test_cases.expected_result: Missing fields checklist details omission of chief_complaint
test_cases.evidence: Checklist correctly flags omission of mandatory chief_complaint

test_cases.name: Fabrication detection and stripping
test_cases.input_setup: Submit payload with injected unauthorized field 'hallucinated_clinical_field'
test_cases.expected_result: Extra unauthorized field cleanly stripped from validated output
test_cases.evidence: Unsanctioned fabricated fields stripped from validated output

test_cases.name: Laterality swap conflict detection
test_cases.input_setup: Cross-check complaint 'left knee' against code description 'right knee'
test_cases.expected_result: Anatomical laterality mismatch detected and flagged
test_cases.evidence: Laterality swap caught: Laterality mismatch detected: Clinical text mentions 'left' (tokens: left), but recommended code specifies 'right'.
